roots.description: Folders whose git repos are all served.

path.description: A folder that holds repos, e.g. "~/work". Every git repo below it is found automatically.

maxDepth.description: How many folder levels below path to look for repos.

exclude.description: Globs (relative to path) of folders to skip, e.g. "archive/**".

group.description: Fixed group for every repo found here; by default the first folder below path is the group.

repos.description: Individual repos, in addition to the roots.

name.description: Repo name shown to the assistant.

group.description: Optional group, e.g. the team or domain.

exclude.description: Globs of files that are never searched or indexed (on top of .gitignore).

blocked.description: Extra regexes for file names that must never be read (on top of the built-in secret list).

loggerNames.description: In-house logger names that mark a log statement, e.g. "AuditLog".

maxResponseTokens.description: Upper bound for one tool answer, in tokens (about 4 characters each).

maxFileBytes.description: Files larger than this are listed but never read, searched or indexed.

searchTimeoutMs.description: A search stops after this long and returns what it found.

maxReadLines.description: Most lines read_code returns in one call.

enabled.description: Build and refresh the background index (recommended).

dir.description: Where the per-repo index shards live, relative to the project folder.

refreshSeconds.description: How often to check whether a repo changed (HEAD, git index).

rescanMinutes.description: How often to re-check every file for edits git has not seen yet.
